prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain consistent with soft tissue strain. Over the course of 20 visits, care included manual therapy, targeted stretching, and supervised home exercise, following a typical and expected treatment progression. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was gradually reduced as symptoms resolved. Examination revealed palpable muscle guarding and reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion, findings that support the reported injury, while neurological screening and orthopedic special tests remained within normal limits. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the clinical presentation. No prior complaints or treatment involving the cervical or lumbar spine were reported in the patient's history. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise, and discharge from active care is anticipated.
